channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Cards Everywhere!
item.description: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

item.title: Far Cry 3 - Blood Dragon
item.description: Far Cry® 3: Blood Dragon is THE Kick-Ass Cyber Shooter.Welcome to an 80’s vision of the future. The year is 2007 and you are Sargent Rex Colt, a Mark IV Cyber Commando. Your mission: get the girl, kill the baddies, and save the world.

item.title: Griftlands
item.description: Griftlands is a deck-building roguelite where you negotiate, fight, steal or otherwise persuade others to get your way. Every decision is important, be it the jobs you take, the friends you make, or the cards you collect.

item.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast
item.description: Snap up Jurassic World Evolution 3: Crocodilia Coast pack to get your hands on 5 family units and a collection of coastal themed scenery pieces to expand your waterside operations!

item.title: Lunch Lady
item.description: Lunch Lady is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. The school final exams are coming up and the best idea you and your friends had was to steal the test answers. Find all 10 pages and don't get caught by the murderous Lunch Lady!

item.title: Assassin's Creed 2
item.description: An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy. New low price!

item.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
item.description: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

item.title: Assassin’s Creed® Brotherhood
item.description: It’s time to join the Brotherhood.

item.title: CONVRGENCE
item.description: CONVRGENCE is an atmospheric VR extraction shooter set in the procedurally generated, ever-changing Chernokamensk Anomaly Zone. Scavenge loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts — all with your loyal dog companion by your side. But extract before nightfall, or face what lurks in the dark.

item.title: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
item.description: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

item.title: Driving Rogue
item.description: Drift, slipstream, and chain risky near-misses at insane speeds to build huge combos. Adapt to procedurally generated streets and challenges, upgrade your ride, unlock abilities, and stack powerful cards to break records. Climb the Redline rankings and fight your way to the top of the leaderboards.

item.title: Kernel Hearts
item.description: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

item.title: Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell Blacklist
item.description: In this stealth-action thriller, a terrorist group known as the Engineers launches the Blacklist, a series of escalating attacks on US interests. Only one man can stop them: legendary covert agent Sam Fisher.

item.title: Dying Light: The Beast - Discharge Weapon Pack
item.description: Embrace the storm with Discharge, an electrifying machete salvaged from the heart of Harran. Designed as a tool of destruction, its charged blade crackles with untamed energy, cleaving through the Infected with a visceral thrill.

item.title: Flamecraft
item.description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

item.title: lily's world XD
item.description: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu

item.title: OpenFront
item.description: A massively multiplayer real-time strategy game pitting hundreds of players against one another. Over one million nuke each other every month.

item.title: Police Chief Simulator
item.description: Welcome to Winston Springs, Officer! The local police station is in urgent need of a Chief of Police, and you’ve been chosen for the job! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

item.title: Sniper Dan
item.description: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

item.title: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410
item.description: Choose from professions like Smith, Preacher or Alchemist to gain riches in this medieval economic simulation. Climb the social ladder, dominate politics, and lead your dynasty to power over multiple generations to ensure your legacy.

item.title: DJMAX RESPECT V - Dungeon & Fighter PACK
item.description: DJMAX RESPECT V - Dungeon & Fighter PACK! Now enjoy the songs of Dungeon & Fighter in DJMAX RESPECT V.

item.title: THYSIASTERY
item.description: THYSIASTERY is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

item.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
item.description: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

item.title: Space Menace
item.description: Space Menace is a sci-fi space RTS and battle game. You play as a space captain, seeking fortune and glory as you see fit. Leave your mark on the world and determine the fate of the galaxy with your decisions.

item.title: Crystal Crisis
item.description: An all-star cast of heroes has gathered to test their mettle in this cute and chaotic new color-matching ONLINE combat game! Crystal Crisis is presented like a fighting game, but players attack by arranging falling crystals and clearing them from the screen. It’s the ultimate Online puzzle battle throwdown!
